content.value_statement: Flemish farm administration requires coordinated parcel, livestock, and manure records. This skill guides AI assistants in preparing checklists and draft records for manual review.
actual_capabilities: Guide preparation of application checklists covering parcels, crops, and ecoregulations.
Structure draft manure declarations around animal counts, manure production, and disposal documents.
Organize parcel records with crop rotation and compliance conditions.
Draft livestock registers and movement records for Sanitel-related preparation.
Outline VLIF investment support questions and application period checks using the guide.
limitations: Coverage is limited to Flemish farm administration.
This folder contains a public text guide, without the original package scripts, extension source, or templates.
Outputs are working documents; users must verify and submit declarations through the relevant official portals.
Annual rules require official verification, and the guide gives conflicting young farmer support percentages: 25 percent and 10 percent.

use_cases.title: Prepare an annual farm application
use_cases.description: Create a parcel, crop, and ecoregulation checklist before completing the official application.
use_cases.target_user: Farmers submitting their own Flemish applications

use_cases.title: Organize manure declaration inputs
use_cases.description: Group animal counts, manure production figures, and disposal documents into a draft declaration checklist.

use_cases.title: Prepare records for an inspection
use_cases.description: Review parcel rotation records and livestock movements, identifying information that still needs confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Start an application checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Flemish farm application checklist for [campaign year], covering parcels, crops, and ecoregulations. Flag rules requiring official verification.

prompt_templates.title: Organize manure declaration records
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [animal counts], [manure production figures], and [disposal documents] to outline a draft manure declaration. List missing inputs without inventing values.

prompt_templates.title: Review parcel and livestock records
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [parcel rotation records] and [livestock movements] for inspection preparation. Produce separate checklists and questions for unresolved entries.

prompt_templates.title: Assess an investment support question
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a VLIF eligibility checklist for [investment] in [year]. Flag conflicting young farmer percentages and unverified application periods before estimating support.

output_examples.input: Prepare an application checklist for my Flemish farm. I have parcel and crop records but have not selected ecoregulations.
output: Parcel records: review identifiers and confirm the application covers every relevant parcel.
Crop records: check the planned crop and rotation information for each parcel.
Ecoregulations: identify possible selections and verify current eligibility rules before submission.
Submission: review the completed working document and enter confirmed information through the official portal.

output_examples.input: I am a young farmer planning a barn investment. Can I rely on the support percentages in this guide?
output: The guide gives conflicting young farmer additions: 25 percent in its example and 10 percent in its FAQ.
Do not calculate a final support amount until current official rates and eligibility conditions are confirmed.
Prepare the investment description, applicant eligibility information, permit status, and relevant application period for review.

best_practices: Provide the campaign year and confirmed parcel, livestock, and manure figures before requesting draft records.
Verify deadlines, ecoregulation conditions, and support rates with the relevant Flemish authorities before relying on them.
Review every draft against source documents and submit only through the appropriate official portal.
anti_patterns: Treating generated working documents as declarations already submitted to authorities.
Applying the guide outside Flanders without checking the relevant regional rules.
Using example subsidy percentages or application periods as verified current entitlements.

faq.question: Does this skill submit declarations automatically?
faq.answer: No. It guides preparation of data and checklists, which users must review and submit through the official portals.

faq.question: Which region does it cover?
faq.answer: The guide covers Flanders. It does not establish requirements for other Belgian regions or countries.

faq.question: Are the 2026 rules independently verified?
faq.answer: No. The guide claims 2026 coverage, but deadlines, rates, and conditions still require verification with official sources.

faq.question: Does this folder include automation scripts?
faq.answer: No. It contains the public SKILL.md guide, without the original package scripts, extension source, or templates.

faq.question: Can it help with VLIF support questions?
faq.answer: It can organize eligibility questions. Its conflicting young farmer percentages prevent treating its examples as reliable final calculations.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: The marketplace lists all three tools. The source describes compatibility with agents that support SKILL.md instructions.
